DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-040-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-040-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: どちらへ向かわれますか。

DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-040-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-040-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 眠って駅を過ぎました。同じ券で戻れますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-040-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 乗り過ごし後の券を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-040-001-SHARED-02.translation: I fell asleep and went past my station. Can I go back using the same ticket?
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-040-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask about using your ticket after missing your station. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-040-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-040-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: お持ちの券と降りたい駅を見せてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-040-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please show me your ticket and the station where you want to get off.

DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-040-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-040-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: こちらです。まだ反対の列車には乗っていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-040-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 券と目的駅と未乗車を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-040-001-SHARED-04.translation: Here they are. I haven't boarded a train going the other way yet.
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-040-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Show your ticket and destination station and explain you have not boarded yet. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-040-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-040-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 券の条件を係員に確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-040-001-SHARED-05.translation: I'll check the ticket conditions with station staff.

DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-040-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-040-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 追加料金がないと決めず、ここで聞いてから戻ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-040-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 追加料金の判断を保留する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-040-001-SHARED-06.translation: I won't assume there is no extra fare. I'll ask here before going back.
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-040-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Hold off on deciding whether an extra fare applies. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-040-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-040-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 今いる駅で改札を出ましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-040-001-SHARED-07.translation: Have you gone through the ticket gates at this station?

DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-040-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-040-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: いえ、ホームにいます。出口へ行く前に確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-040-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 改札未退出を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-040-001-SHARED-08.translation: No, I'm on the platform. I'd like to check before going to the exit.
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-040-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain that you have not exited the ticket gates. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-040-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-040-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 戻る便も合わせて案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-040-001-SHARED-09.translation: We'll also explain the services you can take back.

DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-040-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-040-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。駅を間違えた理由と券の種類を伝えて相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-040-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 事情と券種で係員確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-040-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. I'll explain why I missed the station and the type of ticket, and consult station staff.
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-040-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Check with staff based on your circumstances and ticket type. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-040-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-040-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 反対列車への乗車は待ち、こちらの係員窓口で券の扱いを確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-040-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please wait before boarding a train in the opposite direction and check how to handle your ticket at this staff counter.

DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-041-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-041-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 佐藤さんは、帰宅を希望されたのですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-041-001-SHARED-01.translation: Did Ms. Sato say she wanted to go home?

DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-041-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-041-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 荷物をまとめていたので、そう思いました。帰りたいと言われたわけではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-041-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 荷物整理から帰宅希望を推測したが発言はないと報告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-041-001-SHARED-02.translation: I thought so because she was packing her belongings. She didn't actually say she wanted to go home.
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-041-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Report that you inferred a wish to go home from her packing, but she did not say so. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-041-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-041-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 行動から希望を決めず、ご本人に確認しましょう。持ち物で困っている可能性もあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-041-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let's ask her instead of determining her wishes from her actions. She might be having trouble with her belongings.

DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-041-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-041-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい。かばんの中が見つからないのか、帰る準備なのかを、決めつけず短く尋ねます。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-041-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 行動の目的を決めつけず本人へ尋ねると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-041-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes. I'll briefly ask whether she can't find something in her bag or is preparing to go home, without assuming either.
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-041-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say you will ask her the purpose of her actions without making assumptions. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-041-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-041-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 聞く際に、送迎の車を呼んだと約束しないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-041-001-SHARED-05.translation: When you ask, don't promise that you've called a vehicle to take her home.

DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-041-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-041-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 分かりました。聞いてみると、眼鏡を探すため中を全部出したそうです。帰宅の希望ではありませんでした。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-041-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 眼鏡探しで帰宅希望ではないという本人回答を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-041-001-SHARED-06.translation: Understood. When I asked, she said she had taken everything out to look for her glasses. She wasn't asking to go home.
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-041-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Report her answer that she was looking for glasses, not asking to go home. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-041-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-041-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: その言葉と行動を分けて記録してください。眼鏡は見つかりましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-041-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please record her words separately from her actions. Have the glasses been found?

DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-041-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-041-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: まだです。私が本人のかばんを勝手に調べず、探す手伝いを希望するか本人へ聞きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-041-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 未発見で私物を自己探索せず援助の希望を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-041-001-SHARED-08.translation: Not yet. I won't search her bag without permission; I'll ask whether she'd like help looking.
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-041-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain that the glasses are still missing and you will ask whether she wants help rather than search her belongings on your own. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-041-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-041-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 担当も一緒に対応します。帰宅の連絡は出していませんね。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-041-001-SHARED-09.translation: The person in charge will help too. You haven't sent a message about her going home, have you?

DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-041-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-041-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 出していません。片付けを帰宅意思と誤解したことを訂正し、眼鏡を探したいという本人の用件を伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-041-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 未連絡の帰宅推測を訂正し眼鏡探しを引継ぐ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-041-001-SHARED-10.translation: I haven't. I'll correct my misunderstanding that tidying meant she wanted to go home, and pass along her actual request to find her glasses.
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-041-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Correct the uncommunicated assumption about going home and hand over the request to find glasses. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-041-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-041-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: その内容で引き継いでください。本人の希望に沿って確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-041-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please pass that information along. We'll check in line with her wishes.

DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-042-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-042-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 届いた資材の確認は終わりましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-042-001-SHARED-01.translation: Have you finished checking the materials that arrived?

DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-042-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-042-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 受取欄へ名前を書きました。箱はまだ閉じていますが、それで数量も確認済みになると思いました。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-042-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 受領署名を内部数量確認済みと思ったと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-042-001-SHARED-02.translation: I signed the receipt field. The boxes are still closed, but I thought that meant the quantities had been checked too.
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-042-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you thought signing for receipt meant the internal quantities were verified. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-042-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-042-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 受け取った事実と内部の点検は別です。外箱は何箱ありましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-042-001-SHARED-03.translation: Receiving them and inspecting the contents are separate things. How many outer boxes were there?

DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-042-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-042-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 三箱です。箱数は数えましたが、中の個数は見ていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-042-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 外箱三箱と中の未確認を区別する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-042-001-SHARED-04.translation: Three. I counted the boxes but haven't looked at the number of items inside.
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-042-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Distinguish three outer boxes from the unchecked contents. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-042-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-042-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: その状態を記録してください。内部の確認は指定の担当と行います。いま箱はどこですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-042-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please record that status. The contents will be checked with the designated staff member. Where are the boxes now?

DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-042-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-042-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 受入区画です。点検済みの棚へ運ばず、未確認の札を残しています。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-042-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 受入区画の未確認表示を保っていると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-042-001-SHARED-06.translation: In the receiving area. I haven't moved them to the inspected shelf, and I've left the unchecked tags on.
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-042-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain that they remain in the receiving area with unchecked labels. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-042-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-042-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 担当へ引き継ぎます。納品書の個数をそのまま実数として写さないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-042-001-SHARED-07.translation: I'll pass this along. Don't copy the delivery note's quantity as the actual count.

DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-042-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-042-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 分かりました。書類では六十個ですが、実数は未確認と分けて報告します。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-042-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 納品書数量と実際確認数量を分ける。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-042-001-SHARED-08.translation: Understood. The paperwork says sixty, but I'll report the actual quantity separately as unchecked.
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-042-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Separate the delivery note quantity from the quantity actually verified. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-042-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-042-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 外箱の状態にも気付いたことはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-042-001-SHARED-09.translation: Did you notice anything about the outer boxes' condition?

DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-042-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-042-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 一箱の角がつぶれています。中の破損は未確認です。箱数と外観と内部未点検を伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-042-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 外箱損傷と内部状態未確認を併記して引継ぐ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-042-001-SHARED-10.translation: One box has a crushed corner. I haven't checked for damage inside. I'll report the box count, appearance, and uninspected contents.
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-042-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Hand over the information about outer box damage and the unconfirmed internal condition together. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-042-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-042-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: その情報で確認担当へ引き継ぎます。指示まで未確認区画で保管してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-042-001-SHARED-11.translation: I'll pass that information to the inspection staff. Keep them in the unchecked area until you receive instructions.

DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-043-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-043-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 今日の販売分は、指定の配合で準備されていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-043-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is today's stock for sale being prepared using the specified recipe?

DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-043-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-043-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 試作を味見した人がもっと甘い方がよいと言ったので、砂糖を増やそうと思いました。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-043-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 試作感想で販売配合を変えようとしたと報告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-043-001-SHARED-02.translation: Someone who tasted the trial batch said it would be better sweeter, so I was thinking of adding more sugar.
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-043-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Report that you were going to change the sales recipe based on trial-batch feedback. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-043-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-043-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 試作の感想と販売分の変更指示は別です。まだ増やしていませんか。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-043-001-SHARED-03.translation: Feedback on a trial batch is different from instructions to change the stock for sale. You haven't added any yet?

DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-043-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-043-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 増やしていません。感想をくれたのは同僚で、責任者からの配合変更ではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-043-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 未変更で発言者は指示責任者ではないと示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-043-001-SHARED-04.translation: No. It was a coworker who gave the feedback, not a recipe change from the person in charge.
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-043-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that nothing has changed and the speaker was not the person authorized to direct changes. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-043-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-043-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 意見は報告して、当日の指示を確認しましょう。試作と販売分は分けていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-043-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let's report the opinion and check today's instructions. Are the trial batch and sales stock separate?

DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-043-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-043-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 別の容器です。試作の残りを販売分へ足して、味を近づけることもしません。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-043-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 試作と販売容器を分け混合しないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-043-001-SHARED-06.translation: They're in separate containers. I also won't add leftover trial stock to the sales stock to make the taste closer.
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-043-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain that trial and sales containers are separate and you will not mix them. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-043-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-043-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 配合だけでなく、表示の内容も担当が確認します。変えたつもりで印刷を直さないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-043-001-SHARED-07.translation: Staff will check the labeling as well as the recipe. Don't alter the printout as though the change has been made.

DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-043-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-043-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい。感想のメモだけ残し、販売の配合と表示は現在の指示のまま準備します。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-043-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 感想報告と配合表示変更を区別する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-043-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes. I'll keep only a note of the feedback and prepare the sales recipe and labeling under the current instructions.
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-043-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Distinguish reporting feedback from changing the recipe and labeling. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-043-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-043-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 責任者へ確認します。先に調理を続ける必要がある工程はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-043-001-SHARED-09.translation: I'll check with the person in charge. Is there a step you need to continue cooking first?

DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-043-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-043-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 次の味付けで判断が要るので、そこは待ちます。今できる別の準備があれば指示をお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-043-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 判断が必要な工程を止め別準備の指示を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-043-001-SHARED-10.translation: The next seasoning step needs a decision, so I'll wait there. Please instruct me if there are other preparations I can do now.
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-043-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Pause the step needing a decision and ask for instructions on other preparations. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-043-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-043-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 変更を決めるまで味付けは待ち、別の準備をご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-043-001-SHARED-11.translation: Wait on seasoning until a change is decided. I'll explain other preparations you can do.

DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-044-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-044-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 機械を止めた状況を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-044-001-SHARED-01.translation: Please explain the circumstances when you stopped the machine.

DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-044-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-044-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 異音で止めました。最後の五個はまだ検査していません。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-044-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 異音停止と五個未検査を報告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-044-001-SHARED-02.translation: I stopped it because of an unusual noise. The last five items haven't been inspected yet.
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-044-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Report the stop due to unusual noise and the five uninspected items. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-044-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-044-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: その五個はどこですか。

DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-044-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-044-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 台に残しています。正常品の箱へ入れていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-044-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 正常品未混入と場所を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-044-001-SHARED-04.translation: I've left them on the workbench. I haven't put them in the box for good products.
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-044-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Give their location and explain they have not been mixed with good products. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-044-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-044-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 停止時刻と製品の範囲を記録してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-044-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please record the stop time and the range of products involved.

DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-044-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-044-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 十時二分です。どこから影響があるかは自分で決められません。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-044-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 時刻と影響範囲未判断を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-044-001-SHARED-06.translation: It was 10:02. I can't decide for myself where the affected range starts.
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-044-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Give the time and explain that the affected range has not been determined. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-044-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-044-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 担当が範囲を確認します。設定は変えましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-044-001-SHARED-07.translation: The person in charge will check the range. Did you change any settings?

DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-044-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-044-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 変えていません。原因を試すため再起動もしません。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-044-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 設定変更と再起動をしていないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-044-001-SHARED-08.translation: No. I won't restart it to test the cause either.
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-044-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain that you have not changed the settings or restarted it. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-044-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-044-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 運搬担当にも状態を伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-044-001-SHARED-09.translation: We'll also inform the transport staff of the status.

DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-044-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-044-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 最後の五個は確認待ちと伝え、箱詰めを止めて引き継ぎます。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-044-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 確認待ちの製品を運搬へ引き継ぐ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-044-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll tell them the last five items are awaiting inspection, stop packing, and hand the situation over.
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-044-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Hand over the products awaiting inspection to the transport staff. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-044-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-044-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 停止時刻と五個の場所を確認しました。そのまま分けて、再開と出荷は担当の指示をお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-044-001-SHARED-11.translation: I've confirmed the stop time and the five items' location. Keep them separate and await instructions on restarting and shipping.

DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-045-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-045-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: ご予約のお名前をお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-045-001-SHARED-01.translation: May I have the name on your reservation?

DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-045-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-045-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: リンです。二人泊まりますが、朝食は一人だけにできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-045-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 朝食人数変更を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-045-001-SHARED-02.translation: Lin. Two of us are staying, but can we have breakfast for just one person?
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-045-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Request a change to the number of breakfasts. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-045-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-045-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 宿泊人数は二人のままですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-045-001-SHARED-03.translation: The number of guests is still two, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-045-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-045-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい。友人は朝五時に出るので、朝食だけ変更したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-045-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 宿泊二人と早朝出発を明示する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-045-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes. My friend leaves at 5 a.m., so I'd like to change only breakfast.
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-045-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Make clear that two people are staying and one leaves early in the morning. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-045-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-045-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: プランの変更条件を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-045-001-SHARED-05.translation: I'll check the conditions for changing your plan.

DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-045-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-045-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 朝食不要だから宿泊料金も半分、とは考えていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-045-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 宿泊料金と食事変更を分ける。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-045-001-SHARED-06.translation: I don't assume that not needing breakfast means the accommodation price is also halved.
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-045-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Separate accommodation charges from the meal change. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-045-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-045-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 出発時の受付も案内できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-045-001-SHARED-07.translation: We can also explain the departure desk procedure.

DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-045-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-045-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 鍵を友人が持ち去らず、早朝に返す方法を聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-045-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 早朝の鍵返却を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-045-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'd like to ask how my friend can return the key early in the morning without taking it away.
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-045-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask about returning a key early in the morning. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-045-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-045-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 二人分の鍵と精算方法を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-045-001-SHARED-09.translation: We'll check both guests' keys and the payment procedure.

DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-045-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-045-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 私は後で出ます。二人の出発時刻を分けて伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-045-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 二人の出発時刻を区別する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-045-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll leave later. I'll give our two departure times separately.
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-045-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Distinguish the two guests' departure times. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-045-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-045-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 宿泊二人、朝食変更希望一人、別時刻の出発として担当が条件を案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-045-001-SHARED-11.translation: Staff will explain the conditions for two staying guests, a request to change one breakfast, and departures at separate times.

DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-046-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-046-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 振込のどの段階でお困りですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-046-001-SHARED-01.translation: At what stage of the transfer are you having trouble?

DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-046-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-046-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 実行前の確認画面です。請求書の受取人と、表示された名前の漢字が違います。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-046-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 実行前に受取人の漢字名が違うと申告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-046-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'm on the confirmation screen before executing it. The kanji in the displayed name differ from the recipient's name on the invoice.
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-046-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Report a mismatch in the recipient's kanji name before executing the transfer. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-046-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-046-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: まだ実行していないのですね。入力内容と請求書は照合しましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-046-001-SHARED-03.translation: You haven't executed it yet, correct? Have you compared your entries with the invoice?

DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-046-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-046-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 番号をもう一度見たら、請求書の一桁を読み違えていました。このまま確定せず戻したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-046-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 番号の読み違いを発見し確定せず中止したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-046-001-SHARED-04.translation: When I checked the number again, I found I'd misread one digit on the invoice. I'd like to go back without confirming this.
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-046-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you found a misread digit and want to cancel without confirming. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-046-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-046-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 画面の案内に従って中止してください。こちらから正しい口座を推測して指定はできません。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-046-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please cancel by following the on-screen instructions. We cannot guess and specify the correct account for you.

DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-046-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-046-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 中止できました。違う名前の口座へ送金した状態ではありません。請求元にも番号を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-046-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 未送金と中止完了を報告し請求元に確認すると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-046-001-SHARED-06.translation: I've canceled it. I haven't sent money to the account with the different name. I'll also check the number with the biller.
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-046-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Report successful cancellation and no transfer, and say you will check with the biller. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-046-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-046-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 連絡先はどこから確認しますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-046-001-SHARED-07.translation: Where will you check the contact information?

DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-046-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-046-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 請求書を受け取る前から使っていた担当者の連絡先です。画面に出た名前を受取人として書き換えません。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-046-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 既存連絡先を使い表示名で書類を改変しないと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-046-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll use the contact details for the representative that I used before receiving the invoice. I won't rewrite the recipient as the name shown on the screen.
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-046-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain that you will use existing contact details and will not alter the paperwork to match the displayed name. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-046-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-046-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 確認後にやり直す場合も、実行前の画面を読み直してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-046-001-SHARED-09.translation: If you try again after checking, reread the screen before executing it too.

DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-046-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-046-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。番号を確認し直し、表示名も請求元に照合してから振り込みます。今は操作を終えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-046-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 番号と表示名の照合後に再操作すると決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-046-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. I'll recheck the number and compare the displayed name with the biller before transferring. I'll finish operating it for now.
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-046-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Decide to try again only after verifying the number and displayed name. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-046-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-046-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 画面が初期状態に戻ったことも確認してください。必要なら窓口の利用案内をします。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-046-001-SHARED-11.translation: Also check that the screen has returned to its initial state. If needed, we can explain how to use the counter.

DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-047-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-047-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 差出人はこちらのお名前ですか。

DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-047-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-047-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 作品の作者の名前です。私が頼まれて送るので、作者を送り主に書けばよいと思いました。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-047-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 作者名を差出人欄に使ったと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-047-001-SHARED-02.translation: It's the artist's name. I'm sending it at their request, so I thought I should write the artist as the sender.
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-047-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you used the artist's name in the sender field. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-047-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-047-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 作品の作者と、発送する方の表示は分けて確認しましょう。返送時の連絡先はどなたですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-047-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let's distinguish the work's artist from the person shipping it. Whose contact details should be used if it is returned?

DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-047-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-047-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 私です。作者の住所は知らず、自分の住所と作者名を組み合わせて書きました。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-047-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 自分の住所と作者名を組み合わせたことを示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-047-001-SHARED-04.translation: Mine. I don't know the artist's address, so I combined my own address with their name.
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-047-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you combined your own address and the artist's name. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-047-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-047-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 連絡先と表示が対応するように確認してください。相手へ作者を伝える説明は別に入れられます。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-047-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please check that the contact details and name correspond. You can include a separate explanation identifying the artist for the recipient.

DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-047-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-047-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: では私の発送の表示と、作品に添える作者情報を分けます。作者の住所を推測して足しません。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-047-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 発送者表示と作者情報を分け住所を推測しないと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-047-001-SHARED-06.translation: Then I'll separate my shipping details from the artist information accompanying the work. I won't guess the artist's address and add it.
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-047-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain that you will separate the shipper's details from artist information and will not guess an address. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-047-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-047-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 宛先も確認できていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-047-001-SHARED-07.translation: Have you also checked the delivery address?

DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-047-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-047-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 展覧会の受付です。作品名を受取人名として書いた所もあるので、受付名と作品名を分けて直します。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-047-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 受付名と作品名も混同せず宛先を訂正する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-047-001-SHARED-08.translation: It's the exhibition reception desk. I also wrote the work's title as the recipient in one place, so I'll correct it by separating the reception name and work title.
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-047-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Correct the delivery details without confusing the reception name and work title. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-047-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-047-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 表示を整えてから荷物を閉じ、発送方法を相談しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-047-001-SHARED-09.translation: After putting the details in order, close the parcel and let's discuss the shipping method.

DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-047-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-047-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。自分の連絡先と受付の宛先を確認し、作者名と作品名は中の説明へ書きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-047-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 外の連絡宛先と中の作品情報を区別して準備する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-047-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. I'll check my contact details and the reception delivery address, and write the artist's name and work title in the explanation inside.
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-047-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Prepare the outside contact and delivery details separately from the work information inside. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-047-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-047-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 準備後に、荷物の内容と発送方法をご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-047-001-SHARED-11.translation: Once you're ready, we'll explain the parcel contents and shipping method.

DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-048-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-048-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お帳面はお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-048-001-SHARED-01.translation: Do you have your stamp books?

DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-048-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-048-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 二人分です。一緒に預けても取り違えない方法を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-048-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 二人分の取り違え防止を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-048-001-SHARED-02.translation: These are for two people. Please tell me how to avoid mixing them up if we leave them together.
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-048-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask how to prevent mixing up two people's books. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-048-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-048-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: それぞれの希望箇所を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-048-001-SHARED-03.translation: I'll check where each of you wants the entry.

DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-048-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-048-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 私のはこの頁、友人のは別の頁です。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-048-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 帳面ごとの希望箇所を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-048-001-SHARED-04.translation: This page in mine, and a different page in my friend's.
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-048-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Show the desired page in each book. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-048-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-048-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: お友達の希望は確認されていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-048-001-SHARED-05.translation: Have you checked your friend's wishes?

DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-048-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-048-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい、本人が印を付けています。私の希望で変えません。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-048-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 本人の希望確認を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-048-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes, they marked it themselves. I won't change it to suit my preference.
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-048-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain that you have confirmed your friend's own wishes. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-048-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-048-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 受付の方法を担当が案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-048-001-SHARED-07.translation: The staff member will explain how to submit them.

DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-048-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-048-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 受取票も別なら、各帳面と対応させたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-048-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 受取票と帳面の対応を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-048-001-SHARED-08.translation: If there are separate collection slips too, I'd like to match each one with its book.
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-048-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask for collection slips to correspond to their respective books. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-048-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-048-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 記入まで時間がかかる場合があります。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-048-001-SHARED-09.translation: It may take some time to complete the entries.

DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-048-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-048-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 一冊だけ先に受け取れると決めず、二冊の受取を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-048-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 各冊の受取方法を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-048-001-SHARED-10.translation: I won't assume we can collect just one first; I'll check collection for both books.
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-048-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Check how each book is to be collected. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-048-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-048-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 二冊の希望箇所と受取方法の相談として承りました。担当へこの状態でお渡しください。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-048-001-SHARED-11.translation: I've noted your request to discuss the desired pages and collection method for two books. Please hand them to the staff member as they are.

DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-049-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-049-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: どちらへ行きたいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-049-001-SHARED-01.translation: Where would you like to go?

DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-049-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-049-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 友人の地図ピンの位置にいますが、友人が見えません。橋の下の通路にいます。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-049-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 地図ピン位置で会えず橋の下にいると説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-049-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'm at my friend's map pin, but I can't see them. I'm in the passage beneath the bridge.
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-049-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you cannot meet at the map pin and are beneath the bridge. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-049-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-049-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 友人は橋の上と下のどちらにいるか分かりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-049-001-SHARED-03.translation: Do you know whether your friend is above or below the bridge?

DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-049-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-049-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: そこは聞いていません。平面の地図が同じなら会えると思っていました。先に電話で確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-049-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 上下未確認と認め友人に確認すると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-049-001-SHARED-04.translation: I haven't asked that. I thought we'd meet if we were at the same spot on a flat map. I'll call to check first.
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-049-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Acknowledge that the level is unconfirmed and say you will check with your friend. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-049-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-049-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 確認してから通路を選びましょう。現在地を説明する目印はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-049-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let's choose the passage after checking. Are there any landmarks you can use to describe your location?

DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-049-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-049-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 頭上に橋があり、この案内板の前です。その二つを伝えたら、友人は橋の上だと分かりました。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-049-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 現在地の目印と友人が上にいることを報告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-049-001-SHARED-06.translation: There's a bridge overhead, and I'm in front of this information board. When I told them those two things, I learned my friend was on the bridge.
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-049-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Report your location's landmarks and that your friend is above. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-049-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-049-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 上へ行く通路は案内図で確認できます。友人も移動する予定ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-049-001-SHARED-07.translation: You can check the route up on the information map. Is your friend planning to move too?

DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-049-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-049-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 同時に動くとすれ違うので、友人には上で待ってもらいます。自分だけ案内された通路を使います。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-049-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 友人を待たせ自分だけ移動すると決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-049-001-SHARED-08.translation: We might miss each other if we both move, so I'll ask my friend to wait above. Only I'll take the passage you show me.
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-049-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Decide to have your friend wait and move by yourself. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-049-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-049-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: こちらが上へ向かう入口です。途中で位置が分からなくなったら、次の案内板で確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-049-001-SHARED-09.translation: This is the entrance leading up. If you lose track of your location along the way, check at the next information board.

DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-049-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-049-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。橋を直接登ろうとせず、この入口から進み、上に着いたら友人に連絡します。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-049-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 指定入口を使い上に到着後に連絡すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-049-001-SHARED-10.translation: Thank you. I won't try to climb directly up the bridge; I'll use this entrance and contact my friend when I reach the top.
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-049-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Explain that you will use the designated entrance and make contact after arriving above. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-049-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-049-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: そのようにしてください。地図の位置だけでなく、上の通路だと伝えると分かりやすいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-EXP-049-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please do that. It will be clearer if you say you're on the upper passage, as well as giving the map location.
